title: Happy Nation
scene: Early-1990s Swedish reggae-inflected electronic pop and Eurodance
notes: Melancholy electronic pop hooks sit above reggae-derived syncopation and sharply defined dance grooves.

title: The Bridge
scene: Mid-1990s Swedish Europop crossing dance and acoustic ballads
producers: Per Adebratt|Anders Bagge|John Ballard|Jonas Berggren|Linn Berggren|Douglas Carr|Ulf Ekberg|Tommy Ekman|Max Martin|Denniz PoP|Radiant|Björn Stenström|Zal
notes: Glossy Eurodance singles alternate with guitar-led material, mature ballads and increasingly introspective songs.

title: Flowers
scene: Late-1990s Swedish mainstream dance-pop and adult contemporary
producers: Per Adebratt|John Amatiello|Jonas Berggren|Douglas Carr|Cutfather & Joe|Ulf Ekberg|Tommy Ekman|Ole Evenrude|Charles Fisher|Stephen Hague|Johnny Jam & Delgado|StoneStream
